question: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were actively serving on December 31 of each year from more than 30 years since their first term up to less than 50 years, grouping the results by the exact number of years elapsed since their first term?
sql:
-- Check full range of years_elapsed values
WITH RECURSIVE year_range(year) AS (
    SELECT 1800
    UNION ALL
    SELECT year + 1 FROM year_range WHERE year < 2024
),
male_la_legislators AS (
    SELECT l.id_bioguide, MIN(lt.term_start) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
    GROUP BY l.id_bioguide
),
legislator_terms AS (
    SELECT lt.id_bioguide, lt.term_start, lt.term_end
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
),
legislator_year_active AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ltl.id_bioguide, yr.year,
           mll.first_term_start
    FROM year_range yr
    CROSS JOIN male_la_legislators mll
    JOIN legislator_terms ltl ON mll.id_bioguide = ltl.id_bioguide
    WHERE CAST(CAST(yr.year AS VARCHAR) || '-12-31' AS DATE) <= CAST(ltl.term_end AS DATE)
      AND CAST(CAST(yr.year AS VARCHAR) || '-12-31' AS DATE) >= CAST(ltl.term_start AS DATE)
),
legislator_year_elapsed AS (
    SELECT lya.id_bioguide, lya.year,
           lya.first_term_start,
           CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(CAST(lya.year AS VARCHAR) || '-12-31' AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(lya.first_term_start AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as years_elapsed
    FROM legislator_year_active lya
)
SELECT years_elapsed, COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) as distinct_legislators
FROM legislator_year_elapsed
WHERE years_elapsed > 30 AND years_elapsed < 50
GROUP BY years_elapsed
ORDER BY years_elapsed
